description:
Brand Introduction: BionicGym is a pioneer in wearable fitness technology, offering users an innovative way to enhance their fitness levels through scientifically proven methods. Developed by a team of experts over two decades, BionicGym has gained widespread recognition for its unique approach to fitness, combining technology with the natural physiological process of shivering to help users burn calories and improve cardiovascular health efficiently.

Product Description: BionicGym is a cutting-edge wearable device that stimulates the muscles through gentle electrical impulses to mimic the body's natural response to cold, known as shivering. This safe and FDA-cleared technology targets major muscle groups in the legs to increase heart rate and calorie burn while being gentle on joints. Ideal for anyone looking to boost their fitness levels regardless of their busy schedule or mobility limitations.

USP (Unique Selling Point): BionicGym's standout feature is its ability to deliver a high-intensity cardio workout without the need for strenuous physical activity. This is achieved through neuromuscular electrical stimulation, making it an excellent option for:

  • Individuals with limited time to visit the gym.
  • Those recovering from injuries who require a low-impact exercise option.
  • People working from home looking for an effective way to stay fit.
  • Fitness enthusiasts seeking an innovative and scientifically backed training method.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Rate: Competitive commission structure with a base rate of 6% on all sales generated through affiliate links.
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly, with a 30-day validation period to account for returns and cancellations.
  • Minimum Payout: $100.00
  • Payment Method: Bank transfer

Other Information:

  • Marketing Support: Affiliates have access to a wide range of promotional materials, including banners, graphics, and video content, to enhance their marketing efforts.
  • Exclusive Offers: Periodic incentives and bonuses for top-performing affiliates.
  • Training and Support: Dedicated affiliate manager available to assist with your campaigns and optimization strategies.
  • Restrictions: Affiliates are not permitted to make medical claims about the products or use PPC advertising that competes directly with BionicGym. All promotions must comply with our brand guidelines to maintain a consistent and fair marketplace.

By joining the BionicGym Affiliate Program, you become part of a revolutionary fitness movement with a product that stands out in the market for its efficacy and innovation. We look forward to your partnership in spreading the word about a healthier lifestyle with BionicGym.

Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

By filling out the signup form you acknowledge that you have read our affiliate program terms and conditions, understand, and agree with them.

Joining the Program
By filling out the signup form, and upon acceptance, you will become an affiliate and are bound by the terms of this agreement. Your participation in the program is solely for this purpose: to legally advertise our websites to receive a commission on products purchased by your referred individuals.

 

Affiliate Responsibilities
It is understood that you will introduce our products to your current and prospective customers and will comply with all laws as well as those that govern email marketing and anti-spam laws. It is expected that affiliates will create content based on their own personal experiences of Bionic Gym, without making any falsifications and that affiliates would be active users of the product.


By agreeing to these terms and conditions, you agree to the following additional responsibilities:

  1. You will not make any medical claims or suggest that our products can cure, treat, or prevent any medical condition, illness, or disease. Any claims made must be based on the information provided on our website and must be truthful and accurate.

  2. You will not use stock photos to promote our products. Any images used must be original or obtained through legal means.

  3. You will not use lies, exaggeration, false claims, false reviews, false stats, or any other form of deceptive advertising to promote our products. Any claims made must be based on the information provided on our website and must be truthful and accurate.

  4. You will not use brand bidding on any advertising platform to promote our products. This includes bidding on our brand name or any variations thereof.

  5. You must promptly remove any content related to our products if requested to do so by us.

 

We reserve the right to accept or reject any prospective customers and will pay you a commission per customer referred using your affiliate code according to the designated payment schedule.

 

Either you or we may terminate the Affiliate relationship at any time. You are only eligible to earn Affiliate payments during your time as an approved Affiliate.

We make no express or implied warranties or representations with respect to the program. In addition, we make no representation that the operation of the service will be uninterrupted or error-free, and we will not be liable for the consequences of any interruptions or errors.

 

Revocation of Affiliate Status
Reason for termination of your affiliate application and status in the program may be (but is not limited to) any of the following:

  1. Inappropriate advertisements (False claims, misleading hyperlinks)

  2. Illegal spamming (mass email, mass newsgroup posting, etc.)

  3. Advertising on sites containing/promoting illegal activities

  4. Violation of intellectual property rights

  5. Inability to set up links or refer clients to Bionicgym.com (lack of performance)

  6. Making medical claims or using stock photos, lies, exaggeration, false claims, false reviews, false stats, brand bidding, or any other form of deceptive advertising to promote our products

  7. Failure to promptly remove any content related to our products if requested to do so by us

Affiliate Links

You may use graphic and text links both on your website and in emails. The program may also be advertised "offline" in classified ads, magazines, and newspapers. You may use the graphics and text provided to you by us, or you may create your own as long as they are deemed appropriate according to our terms & conditions.

If you intend to promote our Program via e-mail campaigns, you must adhere to the following:

  • Identify the message as an advertisement in a clear and conspicuous manner;

  • Include the physical address of our business or headquarters;

  • Provide a clear and simple way to opt-out of receiving future email from you;

  • Honor opt-out requests promptly;

  • Monitor and supervise the conduct of third-party marketing entities that promote our website or products on your behalf.

Content Guidelines

As an affiliate of Bionic Gym, you agree not to make any medical claims about our products, including but not limited to claims of curing or treating any diseases or medical conditions. You also agree not to use stock photos in any of your advertising or promotion of our products.

Furthermore, you agree not to use lies, exaggeration, false claims, false reviews, false stats, or any other misleading or deceptive practices in your promotion of our products. You also agree not to engage in brand bidding on any advertising platform when promoting our products.

If we determine that any of your content violates these guidelines, we reserve the right to request that you remove the content immediately. Failure to do so may result in the termination of your affiliate relationship with us.

 

Termination

We reserve the right to terminate our affiliate relationship with you at any time, with or without cause. If we terminate the relationship without cause, we will pay you any commissions earned up until the date of termination. If we terminate the relationship with cause, you will forfeit any unpaid commissions.

 

Governing Law and Jurisdiction

Modification

We may modify any of the terms and conditions of this agreement at any time and at our sole discretion. You will be notified of any changes via email or by a posting on our website. If you do not agree with the changes, you may terminate your affiliate relationship with us.

 

Entire Agreement

This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between you and Bionic Gym and supersedes all prior agreements or understandings, whether written or oral, relating to the subject matter of this agreement.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to abide by the terms and conditions of this agreement, including the content guidelines for promoting our products.
